name: moomem
description: Repo tooling for the MoonBit moomem library. The library itself is moon.mod.

scripts.cov:bisect: pnpm run test:cov && moon coverage report --ignore-missing-files -f summary -p heyq02/moomem/src | python3 -c 'import sys; t=sys.stdin.read(); print(t, end=""); rows=[ln for ln in t.splitlines() if ln.startswith("Total: ")]; num, den = rows[-1].split()[1].split("/"); ratio = int(num) / int(den); print("src coverage {:.2%}".format(ratio)); sys.exit(0 if ratio >= 0.9 else 1)' && moon coverage report --ignore-missing-files -f bisect
